scenarios.title: SCN-0 environment warm-up (not a scenario): compile every route the walkthrough touches so the dev server's first-hit 404 cannot masquerade as a product failure
SCN-1.1 setup: the setup wizard offers only Medal Marks for an adjudicated Country competition (no callbacks option)
SCN-1.3 W4/K1 callback-target readiness blocker: 'Callback target not set' blocks readiness until the organizer sets a target
scenarios.note: No UI path creates a callback_tally round on the wizard's 'custom' event (see the scoring spec for the SS1 path).

scenarios.title: SCN-1.2 setup: owner creates the schedule competition, adds a second division, publishes and opens registration
SCN-0b environment warm-up with the real event (not a scenario): the event layout must pass before the dev server compiles a page below it
SCN-2.1 registration: three buyers pay for four entries with a test card (Avery dances two entries); the Entries page shows them paid
SCN-2.2 eligibility: an ineligible entry is excluded from the schedule; the Schedule page counts the rest
SCN-3.1 generate heats: Avery's two entries land in different heats; no competitor is double-booked; a conflicting move is refused in the UI
SCN-3.2 capacity: a per-division heat size of 2 applies when heats are regenerated with all four entries
SCN-3.3 editing the draft: move a heat, add an empty heat, remove it; numbering stays contiguous
SCN-3.4 publish: the running order is published, survives a reload and is visible to a second manager
SCN-3.5 reschedule: edit the published running order into a draft copy, move a heat, republish; exactly one version is in effect
SCN-5.1 officials: unverified judges cannot be added; after verifying their email the owner adds three, names a chair and builds the panel to 'Panel ready'
SCN-5.2 a judge sees only their own assignment; a non-official instructor sees none; neither can open the competition workspace
SCN-7.1 day-of: schedule and start the round; floor heats move waiting -> on deck -> on the floor -> done, and survive a reload
SCN-6.1 scratch in an open heat: no payment changes, the entry leaves the heat, the day-of console no longer lists it
SCN-6.2 a danced heat refuses the scratch: the page explains why, offers no scratch button, and nothing is written
SCN-6.3a locking prerequisite: the ballot desk for the wizard's Final round says ballots are not available and Lock ballots stays disabled
SCN-6.3 official scratch in a locked heat: the reason is required, the heat stays locked, one audit row
scenarios.note: Locked heat unreachable on the wizard's 'custom' event (the scoring spec covers the SS1 event, where it is blocked by the heat-lock gap).

scenarios.title: SCN-10.1 no-show: an official marks an entry in the active heat as no-show with a reason; the floor console shows it
SCN-10.5 judge ballot page: the no-show entry is not on the judge's sheet, with a note; ballot submission itself is blocked by the setup-scoring gap
scenarios.note: Submitting a ballot (and the stale-ballot correction prompt) is blocked by the setup-scoring gap: the wizard's Final round is 'custom' and ballots are unavailable (SCN-6.3a). Only the note and the missing entry are verified.

scenarios.title: SCN-10.3 a staff member who is not an official is refused: console pages are closed to them and a direct call is rejected; nothing is written
SCN-10.2 void: the official undoes the no-show with a reason; the entry is back, the mark stays as history, the judge note is gone
SCN-10.7 the chair marks a no-show on the ballot desk (reason required); a non-chair judge has no No-shows panel; the mark is attributed to the chair
SCN-10.6 a different studio gets a 404 on the floor console and the judge ballot page and cannot record a no-show
SCN-10.4 after ballots lock, marking a no-show is refused
scenarios.note: Ballots cannot be locked through the UI.

scenarios.title: SCN-7.2 day-of: cancel a round with a reason; the empty Bronze Open round shows Cancelled and stays cancelled after a reload
SCN-8.1 access matrix: owner and admin manage; front desk is sent to check-in; instructor, judge and another studio get 404; anonymous is sent to login
SCN-8.2 database authorization: another studio and an anonymous caller read no heats and cannot list officials; a judge's own assignments come back as theirs only
SCN-9 database integrity: one version in effect, contiguous heat numbers, no double-booked dancer, every scratch audited, no payment moved by a scratch
SCN-4.1 heat-level judge assignment: assign a different judge to one heat of a round
scenarios.note: Panels are per round; no per-heat judge assignment UI.

scenarios.title: SCN-4.2 instructor-to-heat assignment: assign an instructor to a heat and see an instructor conflict
scenarios.note: No instructor/staff-to-heat assignment control.

scenarios.title: SCN-4.3 a real conflict banner: the running order cannot be published while a heat has a shared competitor
scenarios.note: No UI path creates a shared-competitor heat.

scenarios.title: SCN-0c setup (not a scenario): the three judges prove their mailbox through the real sign-in link; the owner does too (reading no-shows needs it)
SCN-1.3 callback target: 'Callbacks + Final' is set up in Advanced settings; the 'Callback target not set' blocker shows until the organizer sets T, then persists
SCN-11.1 callback competition: publish (methods pinned), register and pay four entries, publish the running order, build the panel, start the round and heat
SCN-11.2 callback ballots: a ballot with the wrong number of picks is refused; three judges each submit exactly T picks from their own account
SCN-11.3a callback lock: the manager locks the callback ballots (or the desk states exactly why it cannot)
scenarios.note: No UI path locks the heats: the ballot desk refuses to lock a round while any heat is not locked ('1 heat(s) not locked yet') and heat lock_state changes only through the database function set_competition_heat_lock_state, which no screen calls. Ballots therefore cannot be locked, and results cannot be calculated or approved, through the browser. Evidence: the desk refusal text and a disabled Lock ballots button were asserted.

evidence.lockRefusal: Lock ballots 1 heat(s) not locked yet. Lock ballots Locking stops all new ballots and corrections until a manager reopens the round, with a reason.

scenarios.title: SCN-11.3 callback result: the calculation advances exactly T couples, and the manager sees them
scenarios.note: Depends on SCN-11.3a (lock).

scenarios.title: SCN-11.4 callback ties: a tie at the callback line is resolved within capacity by the approved rule
scenarios.note: Depends on SCN-11.3a; the tie rule is defined by the F1 engine spec and has not been observed through the UI.

scenarios.title: SCN-11.5 the Final of a callback competition is built from the advanced couples and judged in one heat
scenarios.note: Depends on SCN-11.3a; no screen was found in the code that creates the Final's heat from the callback result. To confirm once results can be reached.

scenarios.title: SCN-12.1 ordinal competition: scoring set up and published, four entries paid, running order published, panel ready, heat on the floor
SCN-10.1 no-show: the official marks the last entry as no-show in the active heat
SCN-10.5 judge sheet: the no-show entry is gone from the ranking form, with a note
SCN-12.2 ordinal ballots: three judges rank the three entries who danced from their own accounts
SCN-12.3 lock: the manager locks the ordinal ballots (or the desk states exactly why it cannot)
scenarios.note: No UI path locks the heats: the ballot desk refuses to lock a round while any heat is not locked ('1 heat(s) not locked yet') and heat lock_state changes only through the database function set_competition_heat_lock_state, which no screen calls. Ballots therefore cannot be locked, and results cannot be calculated or approved, through the browser. Evidence: the desk refusal text and a disabled Lock ballots button were asserted.

evidence.lockRefusal: Lock ballots 1 heat(s) not locked yet. Lock ballots Locking stops all new ballots and corrections until a manager reopens the round, with a reason.

scenarios.title: SCN-10.4 after the ballots lock, marking a no-show is refused and the controls are gone
scenarios.note: Depends on SCN-12.3 (lock).

scenarios.title: SCN-6.3 official scratch in a locked heat: the reason is required, the heat stays locked, one audit row
scenarios.note: Depends on SCN-12.3 (lock): a heat is locked only by the lock ballots step.

scenarios.title: SCN-14.1 calculate: the result ranks the entries who danced, excludes the no-show, and a calculator-only approval is refused
scenarios.note: Depends on SCN-12.3 (lock): calculating needs locked ballots.

scenarios.title: SCN-14.2 correction: the manager opens a correction (visible on the results page); the judge's own page still says the ballots are locked
scenarios.note: Depends on SCN-12.3 (lock); also the F2 correction path has no ballot screen (see SCN-14.2b).

scenarios.title: SCN-14.2b a new ballot makes the result stale; approval is refused until it is recalculated
scenarios.note: No UI path submits a corrected ballot while a correction is open (the judge sheet and the ballot desk offer ballot forms only while the round is active). Owner has this as a product gap.

scenarios.title: SCN-14.3 recalculate and approve: a second manager approves, the heat is certified, and a certified heat refuses a scratch
scenarios.note: Depends on SCN-12.3 (lock): approval and certification need a calculated result.

scenarios.title: SCN-14.4 who can see results: judges, the other studio, the instructor, and anonymous visitors cannot open them; the public event page shows none
SCN-13.1 publication: the dancer sees only their own entries and the published placements; a correction republishes as v2
scenarios.note: F3 publication is not built.

environmentNotes.memory: Sampled every 20 s: peak working set of the Next dev server and its node children 4198 MB; peak system memory in use 31966 MB (sampler matches node processes whose command line names the qa-sut-3 worktree, so it may undercount).
environmentNotes.devServer: Restarted fresh between the schedule spec and the scoring spec; the two scoring runs shared one server.
environmentNotes.retriesLogic: Spec-level re-click/re-check helpers as described in the NS1 report section 8; Playwright retries are 0; in-test loop iterations were not instrumented.
